c121.title: Dogs at the Picnic
c121.story: On Sunday, Anna's family has a [[picnic]] in the park. They sit at a table in the old [[pavilion]]. Soon a funny [[bulldog]] comes and looks at their sandwiches. Then a [[beagle]] and a sleepy [[basset]] follow it. Max arrives with his [[husky]] and his aunt's [[collie]]. A friendly [[pit bull]] plays with a ball near the trees. Max's aunt's dog moves the others together by [[instinct]], like sheep. A vet tells them about a [[parasite]] from dirty pond water. So Anna's dad fills a clean bowl for the dogs. Before they go home, Max cleans up his dog's [[excrement]]. Everyone says the park looks nicer than before.

c122.title: Grandma's Farm
c122.story: Anna and Max spend Saturday on Grandma's farm. The [[farmer]] next door waves to them from his field. He drives his big [[tractor]] over forty [[hectares|hectare]] of wheat. Grandma's old [[mule]] is slow, but very strong. It carries ten [[bushels|bushel]] of apples from the [[homestead]] to the road. Behind the house, bees collect [[nectar]] from the flowers. Grandma never uses a [[pesticide]] in her garden. 'Bees are my friends,' she says. Her new tree is a [[hybrid]] of a pear and an apple. 'I want to taste the first fruit!' says Max.

c123.title: Hiking in the Carpathians
c123.story: In July, Anna and Max go [[hiking]] in the Carpathian Mountains. They stay at a small [[camp]] near a high [[cliff]]. Max uses a [[compass]] to find the path to the [[peak]]. On the way, a cool [[breeze]] comes up from the [[canyon]]. They rest under an old [[cedar]] on big [[granite]] rocks. Higher up, they walk across a wide, green [[plateau]]. Anna takes photos of the local [[flora]]: flowers, moss and berries. Then they paddle a [[canoe]] across a quiet mountain lake. On the shore, Max finds a shiny piece of [[quartz]]. Near the lake, they meet boy scouts who love [[scouting]]. Together they climb a hill and see a [[panorama]] of the mountains. Anna smiles, 'Let's come back next summer!'

c124.title: Rangers and Wild Animals
c124.story: In August, Anna and Max visit Max's cousin, a park [[ranger]] in America. On the first morning, he shows them a [[grizzly]] fishing in a cold river. That night, a [[coyote]] howls somewhere near their cabin. In the morning, a [[raccoon]] is digging through their trash can. Later, they drive slowly while a herd of [[bison]] crosses the road. Max laughs at a small [[gopher]] that pops out of a hole in the grass. Then they fly north to Alaska and watch [[caribou]] walk across the tundra. In Nevada, a group of wild [[mustangs|mustang]] runs across the dry plains. Their last stop is a swamp in Florida, where an [[alligator]] lies in the sun. Every evening, Max's cousin warns them to stay on the trail because of [[cougars|cougar]]. On the last night, he makes a fire from [[hickory]] wood, and they roast corn. Anna says it was the best trip of her life.

c125.title: A Voyage at Sea
c125.story: Anna's uncle Petro invites her on a two-week [[voyage]] on his small research ship. Before they leave the river port, an old fisherman shows them a huge [[carp]]. Out at sea, Anna stands on the deck and watches the water all day. Suddenly, an [[orca]] jumps out of the waves right next to the ship! A man on a fishing boat waves and holds up a giant [[marlin]]. That evening, the cook grills fresh [[mackerel]] for everyone on board. In the morning, a [[pelican]] dives and catches a fish in its big beak. For hours, a white [[albatross]] flies quietly above the ship. On the last day, a diver named Olha takes Anna to see living [[coral]]. The [[reef]] is full of colors, and the water is full of tiny [[plankton]]. Through a magnifying glass, Olha shows her a little [[hydra]]. That night, Anna writes in her diary: 'The sea is a whole world.'

c126.title: Anna's Climate Strike
c126.story: On Friday, Anna joins a [[climate]] [[strike]] with other students in the park. Max's sign says, 'I want to see the sky, not [[smog]]!' A girl named Sofia talks about the [[ozone]] layer and why we need it. Another student shows a photo of a melting [[iceberg]] in the Arctic. A teacher explains that cows on big farms produce a lot of [[methane]]. Cars and factories also send carbon [[dioxide]] into the air. Some students ask questions about [[fracking]] and the water under the ground. Anna shares simple [[eco]] ideas, like bikes and reusable bags. A boy says a [[tornado]] once damaged his grandma's house. Sofia adds that one [[tsunami]] can hit towns along a whole coast. 'Bad weather can hurt a whole [[region]] at once,' she says. In the end, the group cleans the park together and plants three small trees.

c127.title: At the Natural History Museum
c127.story: On Tuesday, Anna's little brother Taras visits the natural history museum with his class. First, they see a huge [[dinosaur]] and a [[dodo]], a bird that couldn't fly. In the next hall, Taras's favorite [[primate]] is the [[gibbon]], with its long arms. In a glass case, they see a stone [[artifact]] and a [[fragment]] of mammoth bone. The guide says every living [[organism]] needs food, water and a home. In a warm tank, a [[chameleon]] slowly changes its color from green to brown. Taras finds a silk [[cocoon]] hanging on a small branch. Behind glass, [[termites|termite]] build a mud tower and follow a [[pheromone]] to find food. One room shows the [[fauna]] of Ukraine, from wolves to storks. In the last hall, a model volcano shows red [[magma]] rising from deep underground. On the bus home, Taras says he wants to be a scientist.

c128.title: A Weekend in Paris
c128.story: On their weekend in Paris, Anna and Mama find a small [[bistro]]. The waiter says, 'Bonjour, [[monsieur]],' to an old man. Then he smiles at Mama: 'Good afternoon, [[madame]].' 'And for you, [[mademoiselle]]?' he asks Anna. Anna orders [[madeleines|madeleine]] and [[creme]] brulee, and Mama orders [[brie]]. After lunch, Anna buys a red [[beret]] for twenty [[euros|euro]]. On Sunday, they take a train to an old [[chateau]]. Its stone [[facade]] is white and beautiful. In the evening, they dress up [[a la]] old movie stars. At dinner, a man at the next table drinks [[cognac]]. Mama has a glass of [[pinot noir]], and Anna has juice. 'Merci, Paris!' Anna laughs.

c129.title: Summer Cruise
c129.story: This summer, Max and his parents go on a [[cruise]]. Their [[liner]] is as big as a small town. In Venice, they take a [[gondola]] along a narrow [[canal]]. Then they drink coffee in a sunny [[piazza]]. Max takes photos of an old [[villa]] and a pink [[palace]]. A few days later, the ship stops in Spain. They walk along the [[promenade]] by the sea. Max buys a small guitar as a [[souvenir]] for Anna. In the evening, the whole town dances at a [[fiesta]]. Later, his parents sit in a [[wine bar]] and order [[chardonnay]]. A man at the next table hears them speak Ukrainian. He is a [[compatriot]] from Kyiv, and he lives near their street!

c130.title: Rainy Days in London
c130.story: Anna is taking a summer course in London. On the first day, it rains, and she gets very wet. Her teacher says, 'In London, you need a [[trench coat]].' On Saturday, Anna buys a cheap [[poncho]] and a warm [[jumper]]. She also gets a soft [[fleece]] and a long [[shawl]] for Mama. She pays in [[sterling]] and counts the coins slowly. She eats a [[scone]] with jam and buys [[toffee]] for Max. Later, she visits a small art museum. One old painting there once cost a hundred [[guineas|guinea]]. When Anna gets lost in the rain, a kind [[constable]] helps her. She is wet, but happy.

c131.title: Max's Train Trip North
c131.story: This summer, Max travels across Europe by train with one backpack. In Berlin, his hosts, [[Herr]] and [[Frau]] Weber, take him to a summer music [[fest]]. In the Alps, the nights are cold, so Max buys a warm [[cardigan]]. He sleeps in a wooden [[chalet]] below the castle of an old [[baron]]. When he shouts 'Hello!' from the hill, he hears a long [[echo]]. A local guide explains that every Swiss [[canton]] has its own flag. Everything is expensive, and his [[francs|franc]] disappear very fast. In Norway, he pays in [[krone]] and takes a boat along a deep [[fjord]]. In a museum in Oslo, he sees an old [[Viking]] ship. His last stop is Iceland, where a [[geyser]] shoots hot water high into the air. Max sends Anna a photo: 'Next year, you are coming with me!'

c132.title: Greek Letters in Athens
c132.story: Anna spends a week in Athens with her friend Max. The street signs are in Greek, so she can't read them. Max buys her a little book about Greek letters. The first letter is [[alpha]], and the third is [[gamma]]. Anna finds [[kappa]] and [[mu]] on a bus sign. On a café menu, she sees [[theta]] and [[phi]]. [[Chi|chi]] looks like an X, and [[sigma]] looks a bit like E. 'And [[omega]] is the last one!' Max says. Then they climb up to the old [[citadel]] on the hill. Below it, they get lost in a garden [[labyrinth]]. Anna reads the Greek exit sign and finds the way out!
